title: Add model-selection and prompting field notes for the weak tier
body:
## Background

Parent roadmap: #1540 (weak-local-field-notes-r2).

An independent field PoC found three predictable model-selection and prompting mistakes an adopter is likely to make at the weak-local tier, none of which the current capability-tier documentation warns against: <https://gist.github.com/kurone-kito/8f45ee1ec0c07e8a7fdc8c1f04e83654>.

Evidence: (a) a model that passed a 5/5 single-shot coding battery then spiraled in a multi-turn agentic loop — the single-shot-coding capability knee and the agentic-loop-stability knee were different model sizes entirely, so single-shot benchmarking does not predict loop stability. (b) A verbose reasoning model spec-drifted on literal, fully-specified instructions (returning a generator instead of a list; renaming the target function, causing a `NameError`) while burning roughly 7x the tokens and 2x the wall-time of a leaner, non-reasoning model that followed the spec literally — the reasoning model "improved" on the request instead of obeying it. (c) Routing a weak model through a full agent session (system-prompt injection, on the order of 9K tokens per turn) made it 5-8x slower and lower quality than a direct, minimal-prompt path — the same model that passed a spec directly failed 6/6 through the full agent wrapper, because the extra context pushed it past its reliable zone.

## Proposed change

Add a short model-selection-and-prompting subsection near [Model capability expectations](https://github.com/kurone-kito/idd-skill/blob/main/docs/idd-workflow.md#model-capability-expectations) or "Weak-model guardrails" covering three notes:

1. Select on agentic loop stability, not single-shot pass rate — a model's single-shot coding score does not predict whether it can hold a multi-turn loop without spiraling. Suggest a minimal smoke test (can the model run N turns on a simple task without spiraling) as a cheap gate before committing to a model for loop execution.
2. For mechanical, fully-specified, single-clause steps, prefer a literal, low-reasoning model over a verbose reasoning model — select for obedience, not cleverness, at this tier. Note explicitly that a reasoning model can reduce adherence and inflate cost on this kind of step, so "more reasoning" is not automatically a safer default.
3. At the weak tier, prefer a direct, minimal-prompt generation path (feeding only the atomic task and its acceptance context) over routing the same request through a full agent session with its system prompt and instruction stack — the added context can push a small model past its reliable zone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The new subsection states all three notes, each with its concrete failure mode named (loop-stability-versus-single-shot mismatch, reasoning-model spec-drift, full-agent-wrapper degradation).
- [ ] The notes are stated as adopter-facing guidance, not as a new requirement on this repository's own instructions or tooling.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable; below the configured floor is human-oriented._

_Effort: S -- author-estimated size; a soft autopilot selection tie-breaker only._
